q: Connect Four 的基本规则里，哪些描述是正确的？
q_en: Which statements are true about the basic rules of Connect Four?
options: 棋盘是 7 列 x 6 行
棋子落入某列后会掉到该列最低空格
横向、纵向或两条对角线方向连成 4 个同色棋子即获胜
每回合可以任选一个格子直接放棋
why: 列选择和重力规则决定了合法动作只有列，而不是任意格子。胜负检测要覆盖四个方向。
why_en: Connect Four moves are column drops under gravity, and wins are four-in-a-row in any straight direction.
options_en: The board is 7 columns by 6 rows.
A disc dropped into a column falls to that column's lowest empty cell.
Four same-color discs in a row horizontally, vertically, or on either diagonal wins.
Each turn you may drop a disc into any cell you choose.
optionExplanations: 标准 Connect Four 棋盘确实是 7 列 6 行，这个尺寸决定了列高上限和分支因子。
对，重力是这个游戏的核心机制——棋子只会落到当前列的最低空位，不能悬空。
对，四个方向都要检测：横、竖、两条对角线，漏检一个方向就会漏判胜负。
错，这是井字棋式的错觉——Connect Four 没有任意格落子，动作空间只有列选择。
optionExplanations_en: The board really is 7 columns by 6 rows, which caps column height and the branching factor.
Right — gravity is the core mechanic: a disc always falls to the lowest open cell in that column, never floats.
Right — you must check all four directions: horizontal, vertical, and both diagonals, or you'll miss a win.
Wrong — that's a tic-tac-toe instinct; Connect Four has no free-cell placement, only column choice.

q: find_best_move 函数真正应该返回什么？
q_en: What should find_best_move actually return?
options: 从当前局面和轮到谁走，返回该方应该落子的列
返回从开局到终局的完整对局里发生的所有落子记录
返回当前这盘棋的棋盘是否已经被填满的布尔值
返回每一列当前分别已经落了多少个棋子的高度数组
why: grader 给定中盘局面并检查你返回的列。对手只存在于你的搜索模拟里，不会真的作为外部 bot 对弈。
why_en: The solver must choose the best column for the side to move from a given board position.
scenario: Connect Four 判题程序会反复调用你实现的 find_best_move：每次给一个中盘局面和轮到谁走。
scenario_en: The Connect Four grader repeatedly calls your find_best_move implementation, each time with a midgame board and the side to move.
options_en: Given the current position and whose turn it is, return the column that side should play.
Return the full move-by-move record of every move played across the entire game.
Return a boolean for whether the current board is already completely full.
Return the height array recording how many discs are stacked in each column right now.

termDefinitions.meaning: 本题要实现的函数：输入当前局面，返回一个列号作为落子选择。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: find_best_move is the function under test: given a position, it returns the column to play.

optionExplanations: 对，grader 每次只给一个局面和轮到谁走，你只需要返回这一步该下哪一列。
错，把它当成了要生成整局棋谱，但 grader 只测单次决策，不需要完整对局记录。
错，棋盘是否已满是终局判断的一部分，不是 find_best_move 该返回的东西。
错，高度数组只是棋盘状态的一个切片，不能替代真正要求的落子决策。
optionExplanations_en: Right — the grader hands you one position and whose turn it is, and you just return that one column.
Wrong — that treats it as generating a whole game log, but the grader only tests a single decision, not a full transcript.
Wrong — whether the board is full belongs to terminal checking, not to what find_best_move is supposed to return.
Wrong — a height array is just a slice of board state, not the move decision the function is asked for.

q: Phase 2 的三个热身局面分别考什么前瞻能力？
q_en: What lookahead skills do the three Phase 2 warmup positions test?
options: 一手内直接获胜
两手内看到对手威胁并堵住
五个 ply 内验证强制胜利
完整解出整盘 Connect Four
why: 热身从即时赢、即时防守推进到五层强制胜。它们逐步证明搜索深度是必要的。
why_en: The warmups escalate from immediate tactics to a five-ply forced win.
scenario: Connect Four 判题分 Phase 2 和 Phase 3；Phase 2 用三个热身局面检验基础的前瞻深度。
scenario_en: The Connect Four grader has Phase 2 and Phase 3; Phase 2 uses three warmup boards to check basic lookahead depth.
options_en: Win in one move.
See the opponent's threat within two moves and block it.
Verify a forced win within five plies.
Fully solve the entire game of Connect Four.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对抗搜索里的半步——一方走一次算一个 ply，不是双方各走一次的整回合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A ply is one half-move by a single player in adversarial search, not a full round for both sides.

optionExplanations: 对，第一个热身只要求一步就能看到的直接获胜，验证最基础的终局检测。
对，第二个热身要求往前看两步——自己一步加对手回应——才能发现要堵的威胁。
对，第三个热身把深度提到五层，逼你证明搜索确实能看到更远的强制胜。
错，热身只测几层前瞻，不要求把整局 Connect Four 完全解出来。
optionExplanations_en: Right — the first warmup only needs a one-move win, checking the most basic terminal detection.
Right — the second warmup needs two plies of lookahead, your move plus the opponent's reply, to spot the threat.
Right — the third warmup pushes depth to five plies, forcing the search to prove it can see that far ahead.
Wrong — the warmups only probe a few plies of lookahead, not a full solve of the entire game.

q_en: Fill in: the branching factor is at most about {{7}}, five plies is about {{7^5 = 16807}}, and nine plies is about {{7^9 ≈ 40 million}}.

why_en: Each extra ply multiplies work by roughly the number of playable columns.
scenario: 每列最多 7 个选择；你要估算搜索深度增加时叶子数量怎么增长，来判断朴素搜索还能不能撑住九层强制胜。
scenario_en: At most seven columns are playable; estimate how leaf count grows with depth to judge whether naive search can handle a nine-ply forced win.

scenario: 你要为双人零和、轮流落子的 Connect Four 局面选择最佳列。
scenario_en: You need to choose the best column in a two-player, zero-sum, alternating-turn Connect Four position.
q: 最自然的基础搜索算法是什么？
q_en: What is the most natural baseline search algorithm?
options: minimax：我方最大化分数，对手最小化分数
每次都只选中心列落子，完全不做任何搜索
套用 Dijkstra 算法求单源最短路径
按列编号的字典序固定返回第一列
why: Connect Four 是对抗搜索问题，当前玩家和对手目标相反。minimax 正好表达“我走一步、对手走一步”的递归结构。
why_en: Minimax models alternating adversarial turns by maximizing for one player and minimizing for the other.
whenOtherWins: 如果没有对手或后续状态不受他人决策影响，普通贪心或动态规划可能更直接。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  Root[My move] --> A[Col 2]
  Root --> B[Col 3]
  A --> Aopp[Opponent min]
  B --> Bopp[Opponent min]
  Aopp --> ScoreA[score]
  Bopp --> ScoreB[score]
optionDiagrams:
flowchart TD
  Root[My move] --> A[Col 2]
  Root --> B[Col 3]
  A --> Aopp[Opponent min]
  B --> Bopp[Opponent min]
  Aopp --> ScoreA[score]
  Bopp --> ScoreB[score]

flowchart LR
  Start[Start] --> Heap[Min heap]
  Heap --> Best[Pop cheapest]
  Best --> Relax[Relax edges]
  Relax --> Heap
options_en: Minimax: maximize your own score while the opponent minimizes it.
Always just play the center column with no search of any kind.
Apply Dijkstra's single-source shortest-path algorithm.
Always return the first column in fixed lexicographic order.
tradeoff: minimax 建模双方对抗 vs 无搜索的启发式/图算法捷径

termDefinitions.meaning: 对抗搜索算法：我方节点取子节点最大值，对手节点取子节点最小值，交替进行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Minimax is an adversarial search algorithm that alternates maximizing and minimizing scores down the game tree.

termDefinitions.meaning: minimax 中永远选分数最大分支的一方，本文里是 RED。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The maximizer always picks the branch with the highest score; in this article that is RED.

termDefinitions.meaning: minimax 中永远选分数最小分支的一方，本文里是 YELLOW。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The minimizer always picks the branch with the lowest score; in this article that is YELLOW.

termDefinitions.meaning: 求单源最短路径的经典图算法，跟双人对抗搜索没有关系。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dijkstra's algorithm finds shortest paths in a graph and has nothing to do with two-player adversarial search.

optionExplanations: 对，minimax 用「我方最大化、对手最小化」的交替视角，正好对应两人轮流对抗的结构。
错，只压中心列是一种启发式直觉，完全跳过了看对手怎么回应，无法保证正确性。
错，Dijkstra 求的是单源最短路，没有对抗方，跟两人零和博弈没有关系。
错，字典序第一列是与局面无关的固定规则，等于放弃了任何决策依据。
optionExplanations_en: Right — minimax alternates maximizing for your side and minimizing for the opponent, matching two-player alternating play.
Wrong — always taking the center column is a gut heuristic that skips reasoning about the opponent's reply entirely.
Wrong — Dijkstra solves single-source shortest paths; there's no adversary in it, so it doesn't fit a zero-sum game.
Wrong — returning the lexicographically first column ignores the board completely, so it isn't really a decision rule.

q_en: Fill in: in the article setup, RED is the {{maximizer}} and YELLOW is the {{minimizer}}.

why: 分数用 RED 视角定义：RED 赢是正分，YELLOW 赢是负分。轮到 YELLOW 时它会选让分数最低的分支。
why_en: Scores are from RED's perspective, so RED maximizes and YELLOW minimizes.

termDefinitions.meaning: minimax 中永远选分数最大分支的一方，本文里是 RED。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The maximizer always picks the branch with the highest score; in this article that is RED.

termDefinitions.meaning: minimax 中永远选分数最小分支的一方，本文里是 YELLOW。

q: 朴素 minimax 的叶子评分规则包含哪些？
q_en: Which leaf-scoring rules belong in baseline minimax?
options: RED 已连四得 +1
YELLOW 已连四得 -1
深度耗尽但无人获胜得 0
棋盘未满但深度耗尽时必须继续搜索到满盘
why: 最简单规则只区分胜、负、未知或平。深度用完还看不到胜利时，当前实现只能给 0。
why_en: The baseline scorer maps RED wins, YELLOW wins, and unresolved leaves to +1, -1, and 0.
options_en: RED already has four in a row scores +1.
YELLOW already has four in a row scores -1.
Depth runs out with no winner scores 0.
If the board isn't full when depth runs out, the search must keep going until the board is full.
optionExplanations: 对，RED 连四是这套评分里唯一的正向终局，直接记 +1。
对，YELLOW 连四对称地记 -1，因为分数始终站在 RED 视角。
对，深度用完还看不出胜负时，朴素规则干脆给 0，当作未知处理。
错，深度耗尽就该按当前规则返回 0，不能违反预算硬去搜到棋盘填满。
optionExplanations_en: Right — RED connecting four is the one positive terminal in this scoring, scored +1.
Right — YELLOW connecting four mirrors that as -1, since scores are always from RED's perspective.
Right — when depth runs out with nothing resolved, the baseline rule just scores it 0 as unknown.
Wrong — once depth runs out, the rule returns 0; it can't blow the depth budget by forcing a search to a full board.

scenario: YELLOW 已经在底行 0、1、2 列形成三连，下一手可在 3 列获胜；现在 RED 走。
scenario_en: YELLOW already has three discs on bottom-row columns 0, 1, and 2, and can win in column 3 next; RED moves now.
q: RED 至少需要搜索多深才能看出应该堵 3 列？
q_en: How deep must RED search to see that column 3 should be blocked?
options: 只看 RED 自己下一手，不看对手回应
看两步：RED 一手加 YELLOW 回复
搜索到棋盘填满才停止
不用搜索，随手选一列
why: RED 若不堵，YELLOW 下一手就赢。这个威胁只有把对手回复纳入树里才可见。
why_en: Blocking the threat requires seeing the opponent's immediate winning reply.
whenOtherWins: 如果当前玩家自己已有立即取胜列，就一层搜索已经足够。
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Red[RED move] --> Block[Block col 3]
  Red --> Skip[Skip block]
  Skip --> Yellow[YELLOW wins]
options_en: Only look at RED's own next move.
Look two plies ahead: RED's move plus YELLOW's reply.
Search all the way until the board is completely full.
No search needed, pick any column at random.
tradeoff: 只看己方一手 vs 看两手（含对手回应）

termDefinitions.meaning: 对抗搜索里的半步——一方走一次算一个 ply，不是双方各走一次的整回合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A ply is one half-move by a single player in adversarial search, not a full round for both sides.

optionExplanations: 错，只看自己一步根本看不到 YELLOW 下一手就能连四的威胁，等于没堵。
对，往前看两步——自己一手加对手回复——正好能看到 YELLOW 的即时获胜威胁并堵住它。
错，搜到棋盘填满远超这里需要的深度，白白浪费预算才能得到同样的堵子结论。
错，随手选列完全不检查威胁，堵对列纯属运气。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — looking only at RED's own move can't see that YELLOW wins next turn, so nothing actually gets blocked.
Right — two plies ahead, RED's move plus YELLOW's reply, is exactly enough to spot and block YELLOW's immediate win.
Wrong — searching all the way to a full board is far deeper than needed here, wasting budget for the same answer.
Wrong — picking a column at random never checks the threat, so blocking the right column is pure luck.

q: `find_best_move` 和 `_minimax` 分成两个函数的原因是什么？
q_en: Why split find_best_move and _minimax into two functions?
options: 根节点要返回列，递归内部只需要返回分数
Python 不允许递归函数返回整数
根节点不能调用 `drop_disc`
内部递归必须直接打印棋盘
why: 根层要记住哪个动作产生最佳分数。子树只把局面价值传回上层即可。
why_en: The root needs a move choice, while recursive nodes only need to return scores.
options_en: The root needs to return a column; recursive nodes only need to return a score.
Python does not allow a recursive function to return an integer.
The root node is not allowed to call drop_disc.
The inner recursion must print the board directly.
tradeoff: 根节点要选列 vs 子节点只需要返回分数

termDefinitions.meaning: 本题要实现的函数：输入当前局面，返回一个列号作为落子选择。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: find_best_move is the function under test: given a position, it returns the column to play.

optionExplanations: 对，根节点还要记住是哪一列产生了最佳分数，子树只需要往上传一个分数。
错，这是编造的语言限制——Python 递归函数当然可以返回整数。
错，根节点完全可以调用 drop_disc 模拟落子，这不是限制的来源。
错，递归内部不需要打印棋盘，这只是无关的调试动作，不是拆函数的原因。
optionExplanations_en: Right — the root also needs to remember which column produced the best score; subtrees only need to pass a score up.
Wrong — that's a made-up language limitation; Python recursive functions can return integers just fine.
Wrong — the root can absolutely call drop_disc to simulate a move; that's not what forces the split.
Wrong — the inner recursion doesn't need to print the board; that's an unrelated debugging action, not the real reason.

scenario: 递归调用进入一个已经有人获胜的局面，同时剩余深度可能为 0。
scenario_en: A recursive call enters a position where someone has already won, and the remaining depth may also be zero.
q: 为什么必须先检查 winner，再检查 depth？
q_en: Why must winner be checked before depth?
options: 否则刚刚形成的胜负可能被深度耗尽误判成 0
否则 `valid_moves` 会变慢
否则不能撤销落子
否则 alpha-beta 无法初始化
codeSample:
winner = self.board.check_winner()
if winner == Player.RED: return WIN_SCORE
if winner == Player.YELLOW: return -WIN_SCORE
if depth == 0 or self.board.is_full(): return 0
why: 胜负局面有确定分数，不应该因为刚好到达深度边界而被当成未知。终局检查要优先。
why_en: Terminal wins must be scored before depth exhaustion so a real win is not treated as an unknown leaf.
whenOtherWins: 如果评分函数明确把 depth==0 时的 winner 也纳入启发式，顺序可以封装不同，但必须保留终局优先语义。
options_en: Otherwise a just-formed win could be misjudged as 0 when depth also runs out.
Otherwise valid_moves would run slower.
Otherwise the move could not be undone.
Otherwise alpha-beta could not be initialized.
tradeoff: 先查终局胜负 vs 先查深度耗尽

termDefinitions.meaning: 检查棋盘上是否已经有一方连成四子的函数或返回值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: check_winner (or winner) checks whether either player already has four in a row on the board.

termDefinitions.meaning: 代码里表示"必胜/必败"的极值分数常量，让胜负分和普通分数拉开差距。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: WIN_SCORE is the constant score used for a guaranteed win or loss, set far apart from ordinary scores.

optionExplanations: 对，先查 winner 能保证刚形成的胜负不会被恰好用完的深度误判成中性的 0 分。
错，检查顺序跟 valid_moves 的性能没有关系，这是编造的因果。
错，撤销落子由 undo_move 负责，跟先查 winner 还是先查 depth 无关。
错，alpha-beta 的初始化只需要设初值，不依赖这里的检查顺序。
optionExplanations_en: Right — checking winner first guarantees a just-formed win isn't misread as a neutral 0 just because depth also hit zero.
Wrong — the check order has nothing to do with how fast valid_moves runs; that's a made-up connection.
Wrong — undoing a move is undo_move's job, unrelated to whether winner or depth gets checked first.
Wrong — alpha-beta only needs its bounds initialized once, independent of this check's ordering.

scenario: minimax 要在同一个棋盘上试很多列，并且每次递归后恢复原局面。
scenario_en: Minimax must try many columns on the same board and restore the original position after each recursive branch.
q: 最合适的实现方式是什么？
q_en: What implementation style fits this search best?
options: 每次落子都复制一份新棋盘对象
原地修改棋盘，递归结束后撤销落子
只记录列号，棋盘保持不变
把棋盘写入文件，用完再读回
why: 原地试探加撤销是回溯的标准形状，避免大量棋盘拷贝。关键是不管分支如何结束都要配对撤销。
why_en: Drop-and-undo backtracking avoids allocating a new board for every searched node.
whenOtherWins: 如果棋盘很小且实现撤销容易出错，复制状态可以换取更简单的正确性。
options_en: Copy a brand-new board object after every move.
Mutate the board in place, then undo the move on the way back.
Only record the column number and leave the board unchanged.
Write the board to a file and read it back afterward.
tradeoff: 原地回溯（省拷贝） vs 每步复制棋盘（更简单但更贵）

termDefinitions.meaning: 原地修改棋盘的落子与撤销函数，用于回溯而不必复制整个棋盘。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: drop_disc and undo_move mutate the board in place so backtracking avoids copying the whole board.

optionExplanations: 每次复制棋盘更简单也更不容易写错，但当棋盘小、撤销逻辑容易出 bug 时才值得用空间换正确性；这里搜索节点太多，复制代价太高。

termDefinitions.meaning: 在 minimax 上加两个边界值，一旦证明某分支不会影响根节点的选择就直接跳过。

Wrong — pruning can trigger at any node throughout the search tree, not only once the board is full.

q: transposition table 应该如何管理？

Clear the cache every time a recursive node is entered.
Persist it to disk forever, without distinguishing which root position it came from.

Wrong — clearing the cache on every recursive node means the table gets rebuilt for nothing, with zero reuse benefit.
Wrong — persisting to disk forever without distinguishing the root position would let scores from different positions contaminate each other.

两者都代表 YELLOW 已经赢
因为 0 是唯一允许的返回值

options_en: Neither has a clear winner to point at under this simple scoring rule.
Both represent RED already winning.

Because 0 is the only value the function is allowed to return.

不看当前局面是什么，强制固定返回中心那一列
直接跳过对手这一方的视角，完全不做对抗搜索

Ignore what the current position actually looks like and always return the center column.
Skip the opponent's side of the perspective entirely and do no adversarial search at all.

固定预算这种搜索方式从来不会返回一个 best move

termDefinitions.meaning: 从浅到深逐层完整搜索，每层结束都留一个可直接返回的当前最佳走法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Iterative deepening searches depth by depth from shallow to deep, keeping a returnable best move after each completed depth.

optionExplanations: 对，固定深度是提前定好搜几层，固定预算则逐层加深，直到预测下一层已经不适合再跑为止。
错，迭代加深每完成一层都留有可返回的最佳列，从不是「不返回」。
错，固定深度搜索完全可以叠加 alpha-beta 剪枝，两者不冲突。
错，固定预算按迭代加深逐层搜索，走法由搜索结果决定，不是随机落子。
optionExplanations_en: Right — fixed depth decides how many levels upfront; a fixed budget instead deepens level by level until the next depth is predicted not to fit anymore.
Wrong — iterative deepening leaves a returnable best column after every completed depth; it never fails to return one.
Wrong — fixed-depth search can absolutely be paired with alpha-beta pruning; there's no conflict.
Wrong — a fixed budget still searches depth by depth via iterative deepening, so the move comes from the search, not from random drops.

q: 最终搜索实现必须维持哪些正确性不变量？

options: 每个 simulated drop 都必须撤销
赢家检查要早于深度耗尽的中性返回
TT key 不能把不同深度或不同走棋方混在一起
剪枝可以跳过任何看起来慢的分支，即使边界未证明
why: 这些不变量保证优化不改变 minimax 语义。未经证明的随意跳过会变成启发式错误。
why_en: Correct search optimizations preserve board state, terminal semantics, and cache-key validity.
options_en: Every simulated drop must be undone.
The winner check must run before a depth-exhausted neutral return.
The transposition table key must not conflate different depths or different sides to move.
Pruning may skip any branch that looks slow, even without a proven bound.

optionExplanations: 对，每次模拟落子都必须配一次撤销，否则回溯会给后续节点留下脏棋盘。
对，赢家检查要先于深度耗尽的中性返回，不然刚形成的胜负会被误判成 0。
对，TT key 必须区分深度和走棋方，否则会把语义不同的搜索状态错误共享同一分数。
错，只有边界证明某分支不会影响结果才能剪，「看起来慢」不是合法的剪枝依据，会破坏正确性。
optionExplanations_en: Right — every simulated drop must be paired with an undo, or backtracking leaves a corrupted board for later nodes.
Right — the winner check must run before a depth-exhausted neutral return, or a just-formed win gets misread as 0.
Right — the TT key must distinguish depth and side to move, or it wrongly shares one score across semantically different search states.
Wrong — only a proven bound justifies pruning a branch; 'looks slow' isn't a valid basis and would break correctness.
